Research Scout update — 2026-09-11

Material change to this candidate: the **official** `a2aproject/a2a-cli` shipped **v0.2.0 on 2026-09-09** (non-prerelease). Primary release: https://github.com/a2aproject/a2a-cli/releases/tag/v0.2.0

Why this matters: the official CLI now provides a stable, scriptable A2A client surface for agent-card discovery, send/stream, task inspection/cancel, JSON output and predictable exit codes. More importantly for ChitAkasha/NICLI, v0.2.0 includes a **custom transport plugin contract**: an `a2a-transport-<name>` binary on PATH can proxy a non-native transport without recompiling the CLI. The project ships a `clitransport` devkit and runnable echo plugin. README at the v0.2.0 tag: https://github.com/a2aproject/a2a-cli/blob/v0.2.0/README.md

Decision-relevant implication: Issue #96 should test the **official CLI/plugin seam first**, before evaluating a larger a2acode/ACP bridge. A tiny read-only plugin could potentially wrap the existing mailbox transport or a synthetic local transport while preserving the current authority model; if this works, we may get a standard A2A operational surface without replacing mailbox leases/Gatekeeper/Research Market.

Smallest falsification test (still NOT execution-authorized): inspect the v0.2.0 plugin API + echo example and determine whether a plugin can carry our immutable task envelope/receipt semantics without weakening task binding, idempotency, cancellation, or fail-closed authority checks. No Codex needed; local source review only.

Risk/uncertainty: the **CLI software release is v0.2.0, but its behavior specification is still v0.2/Review**, so do not treat the command contract as final standard. This strengthens the candidate's option value, not production-readiness.

Quota note: this finding requires no Codex admission and is consistent with `research/quota-governor-v0.md` specialist→web/Git→candidate routing.

body: Compatibility note: PR #109 (5e20f4c) contains a local A2A/ACP-like reference probe. It is deliberately not an authorization migration: no real identity, credentials, paid inference, account, listener, or private host access is used. The result is REDESIGN because the boundary needs explicit SSI/mandate/action-binding semantics before production interoperability.
